name: azer
description: an Azer, a stocky fire dwarf: bronze-orange skin, blazing yellow-orange flame hair and a huge flame beard, a scowling brow, bare muscular arms, a bronze-studded armoured kilt with a round bronze belt boss, bronze greaves and boots, a bronze war hammer with a blocky head and a ridged handle raised beside his head in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, and a round studded bronze shield on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side
hands: the war hammer stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the round bronze shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-right, the bronze war hammer is lifted beside the head with its blocky head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hammer hand behind the head and the war hammer's bronze head hanging down behind the shoulders to the right, the round bronze shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips round, the hammer arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the war hammer is level, its bronze head pointing to the left
strike.4: contact: hammer arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the war hammer smashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the war hammer carries on down until its bronze head nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, the flame hair and flame beard trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the war hammer comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (hammer arm thrown up and out to the right, the round bronze shield flung out to the left)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the war hammer dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, hammer arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the war hammer lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the war hammer's bronze head resting on the ground at the lower-left, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the war hammer slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right; the war hammer lies on the ground at the lower-left; the round bronze shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks, the flames of his hair and beard flicker lower
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, his flame hair and beard dimmed to low flickering flames, the war hammer and the round bronze shield on the ground beside him
